hints.title: Count Multiples using Inclusion-Exclusion
hints.text: The number of multiples of a, b, or c up to x equals x/a + x/b + x/c - pairwise least common multiples + triplet least common multiple.

hints.title: Check Monotonicity
hints.text: As x increases, the count of valid numbers up to x is non-decreasing, enabling binary search on x.

hints.title: Search Range up to 2 * 10^9
hints.text: Perform binary search in range 1 to 2 * 10^9 finding the smallest integer x where count(x) is at least n.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating or checking numbers one by one up to the nth target takes O(N) operations, which times out for N = 10^9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary search combined with inclusion-exclusion count runs in about 32 steps and constant memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should compute LCM using GCD properly and guard against 64-bit integer overflow during multiplication.
complexity.notes: Search upper bound 2 * 10^9 suffices because n <= 10^9 and a, b, c >= 1.
